name: Reverse Pec Deck (machine rear delt fly)
camera: Side three-quarter view facing right, showing athlete seated facing the machine chest pad with vertical arms
equipment: Pec deck machine with chest support pad, seat, and dual pivoting rear-delt lever arms with vertical handles
positionA: Left panel: Athlete sits facing the machine with chest pressed against the support pad, feet flat on the floor, arms reaching forward in front of chest holding vertical handles with elbows softly unlocked (start position).
positionB: Right panel: EXACT SAME machine frame, seat, and posture. Athlete pulls handles outward and backward in a wide horizontal arc until arms align with the coronal plane of the shoulders, squeezing rear deltoids; fixed soft elbow bend maintained; chest remains firmly against pad.
mechanics: Shoulder horizontal abduction isolating posterior deltoids. Torso and chest pad remain completely stationary.
avoid: Do not show chest press/chest fly, do not arch spine away from pad, no rowing with bent elbows, no extra limbs, no text/labels/arrows.

Both poses show the same equipment and geometry
